jsonld.description: Electrical contractor based in Westchester, Miami, FL, handling panel upgrades, outlet and fixture repairs, lighting installation and electrical hookups for signs, for both homes and businesses.

parrafo.es: Electric & Signs Service atiende hogares y negocios en Westchester y el area de Miami: reparacion de tomacorrientes y paneles, actualizaciones electricas, instalacion de iluminacion y conexiones electricas para letreros comerciales. Diagnostico claro y trabajo terminado sin vueltas.
parrafo.en: Electric & Signs Service handles homes and businesses across Westchester and the greater Miami area: outlet and panel repairs, electrical upgrades, lighting installation and electrical hookups for commercial signs. Clear diagnostics and work finished without the runaround.

hero.imagen_alt: LED area lighting fixture installed by Electric & Signs Service on a commercial pole

parrafo_1.es: Electric & Signs Service es un equipo de electricistas que atiende Westchester y el area de Miami. Jose se encarga de diagnosticos y reparaciones (desde un tomacorriente de estufa hasta iluminacion completa), y Angel atiende clientes con multiples propiedades que necesitan un electricista de confianza para trabajos chicos y grandes.
parrafo_1.en: Electric & Signs Service is a team of electricians serving Westchester and the greater Miami area. Jose handles diagnostics and repairs, from a stove outlet to full lighting work, and Angel works with clients who manage multiple properties and need one dependable electrician for small jobs and large ones alike.

parrafo_2.es: Lo confirman sus clientes: respuesta rapida, trabajo honesto y puntualidad, ya sea una reparacion de emergencia en casa o el mantenimiento electrico de un local comercial.
parrafo_2.en: Their clients confirm it: quick responses, honest work and reliable scheduling, whether it is an emergency repair at home or the electrical upkeep of a commercial property.

texto.es: Nos cuentas el problema o el proyecto: reparacion, panel, iluminacion o conexion de un letrero. Respuesta directa, sin call center.
texto.en: Tell us the problem or the project: a repair, a panel, lighting or a sign hookup. Direct answers, no call center.

texto.es: Revisamos la instalacion y te explicamos con claridad que hace falta antes de tocar nada.
texto.en: We check the wiring on site and walk you through exactly what is needed before touching anything.

texto.es: Te damos el detalle segun el alcance real del trabajo, sin sorpresas al final.
texto.en: We give you the detail based on the real scope of the job, no surprises at the end.

texto.es: Ejecutamos el trabajo y dejamos todo probado y funcionando antes de irnos.
texto.en: We carry out the work and leave everything tested and running before we leave.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el alcance real, escribenos o llamanos y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the real scope, call or reach out and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Tomacorrientes, salidas de estufa y fallas electricas diagnosticadas y reparadas el mismo dia, como en nuestros trabajos de cocina.
texto.en: Outlets, stove connections and electrical faults diagnosed and repaired, same day in most cases, the kind of fix our stove-outlet reviews describe.

texto.es: Reemplazo de paneles, medidores y cableado para casas y edificios, hecho con permisos y materiales certificados.
texto.en: Panel replacement, meter work and wiring for homes and buildings, done with proper permitting and certified materials.

texto.es: Desde iluminacion interior hasta luminarias LED comerciales en postes y fachadas, instaladas y conectadas de forma segura.
texto.en: From interior lighting to commercial LED fixtures on poles and storefronts, installed and wired safely.

texto.es: Conexion electrica de letreros comerciales y mantenimiento del panel que los alimenta, para negocios en Westchester y Miami.
texto.en: Electrical hookups for commercial signs and upkeep of the panel feeding them, for businesses across Westchester and Miami.

items.quote: Jose quickly diagnosed the issue with my stove/oven outlet, got a replacement, and installed it, and now the heating elements are working perfectly. He was professional, efficient, and knowledgeable, and I would definitely recommend his services

Jose has been such a pleasure to work with. He is responsive, has a sense of urgency and great customer service. For all our lighting needs, he has just been so dependable and honest. Thank you for your help!

I have multiple properties and when I need any type of Electrical service I entrust the work to Angel. He is professional, on time, always providing an excellent service. If you have a small or large job, and you need an experienced, knowledgeable electrician, I would look no further.
